summary: Verified fix for user-reported Razorpay popup non-interactivity bug (Radix dialog pointer-events:none leak). Tested both product page (/products/ai-business-ideas-2026) and combo page (/meta-ads-decode). On both: email dialog is removed from DOM before Razorpay opens, document.body pointer-events = 'auto', Razorpay's Contact Details popup is fully interactive — mobile input accepted '9999999999' and '8888888888' respectively, email prefilled with 'delivered@resend.dev', Continue button clickable. No real payment was initiated.
critical_code_review_comments: lib/razorpay.js already clears body pointer-events before rzp.open() — belt-and-braces guard works as intended.

CheckoutButton.handleEmailSubmit closes the Radix dialog (setEmailOpen(false)) BEFORE awaiting startRazorpayCheckout — correct ordering. Note: since startRazorpayCheckout internally also clears pointer-events, even if a future refactor reorders these calls, the guard will keep the iframe interactive.
Minor: the many Mixed Content console warnings on the Razorpay iframe loading http://localhost:*/*.png images are Razorpay-side (not our app) — safe to ignore.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix fully verified on product page + combo page. Could not programmatically verify the Razorpay X-close dismiss flow because the close button inside the Razorpay iframe doesn't expose standard aria-label/class='close' selectors — this is Razorpay-side and unrelated to our fix. The underlying page body pointer-events remain 'auto' while the popup is open, so dismissing it will leave the page in a normal state. No action required.
rca of the issue: ROOT CAUSE: Radix UI Dialog sets `pointer-events: none` on document.body while any dialog is open to disable background interactions. The old flow called startRazorpayCheckout BEFORE closing the Radix email dialog, so when the Razorpay iframe mounted on top of the page it inherited an un-interactable body — iframe visible but all clicks/typing swallowed. FIX VERIFIED: (a) handleEmailSubmit now calls setEmailOpen(false) before awaiting startRazorpayCheckout, allowing Radix to restore body pointer-events; (b) startRazorpayCheckout additionally force-clears document.body.style.pointerEvents immediately before rzp.open() as a safety net for other entry points. Observed in test: body pointer-events computed='auto', email dialog removed from DOM, mobile and email fields fully typable.
